title: Ambiguous "happen" Mentions
summary: The fragments are brief and context-poor mentions of events happening or not happening, without enough information to determine a consistent customer sentiment or single concrete issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention intermittent behavior, unmet promises, price-class expectations, valet mode, and a recording feature question, but the fragments are too incomplete to classify sentiment reliably.

limitations: All sampled fragments are classified as undetermined, so there is no sentiment-resolved evidence to compare.
The topic cluster mixes several possibly unrelated subjects rather than one clearly coherent issue.
The excerpts are very short and lack surrounding context, which prevents reliable interpretation of what specifically happened and how the reviewer felt.
